system.name: OLTQA model
system.one_liner: Prompt-enhanced QA model for open long-tailed QA: a prompt pool shares knowledge across tasks, retrieve-then-rerank mines knowledge from a large LM.

content.variant_note: two titled branches (mining, sharing) build one prompt for a black-box QA model; a framed chat panel replays one question
content.argues: Two ingredients help a QA model on head, tail and unseen tasks: instance-level prompt sharing and knowledge mined from a pre-trained LM, both delivered to model F as prompts.
content.subject: Knowledge-mining and knowledge-sharing branches building the prompt for QA model F, plus a chat-style trace of one question.

lessons.what_to_learn: Pair the abstract framework with a framed trace of one question drawn as a chat, and reuse the chip colours of the framework inside the prompt bubble so the two views map onto each other; title and tint each contribution as its own region.
lessons.suits: Prompt-based or retrieval-augmented NLP methods whose novelty is two add-on modules feeding a black-box model and whose effect is easiest to see on one text example.

evidence: Two key ingredients introduced in our model
Knowledge mining from a pre-trained LM g using a retrieve-then-rerank framework
dynamically combine these prompts based on c and q to obtain Pm

summary: The paper defines open long-tailed QA, where one QA model must serve head, tail and unseen tasks, and proposes a prompt-enhanced encoder-decoder QA model with two additions. Figure 1 shows both. On the left, a green Knowledge Mining region takes the input (c, q), retrieves examples from the training set D_tr, lets LM g write candidate texts such as Clerk and In bank, and a re-ranker passes the chosen ones on as the knowledge prompt. Below it, a yellow Knowledge Sharing region matches the input against prompt keys and picks meta prompts from a pool. Both prompts are joined and fed with the input to QA model F, which outputs the answer. A dashed inset spells out the LM g call, and a framed chat panel replays 'What is John's job?' down to 'bank clerk'.
summary_zh: 论文提出开放长尾问答，用知识共享（提示池按键值选取元提示）和知识挖掘（检索、LM g 生成候选、重排序得到知识提示）增强 QA 模型 F；左侧为框架，右侧框内用聊天气泡演示一个问题如何得到答案 bank clerk。
notes: Prior labels kept (model-anatomy, worked-walkthrough); stage-pipeline added because the mining branch is an ordered retrieve, generate, re-rank chain. The caption speaks of (a) and (b) but no letters are drawn: the two regions carry bold titles instead. I count two panels, the unframed left framework (with the dashed inset) and the black-framed chat. The Re-ranker's exact inputs and the role of the dashed inset are read from the drawing, not labelled. The preview PNG shows the top of the caption text at its bottom edge, which is not part of the figure. #deebf7 and #e1fbd3 are assigned by area.
